title: A Drive to Salò
introTitle: A change of pace along Lake Garda.
intro: After unforgettable days exploring the Dolomites, today's adventure takes me to Lake Garda, Italy's largest lake. Today's destination is Salò, a charming town along the southwestern shore, known for its beautiful waterfront promenade, historic buildings and views across the lake. After days of dramatic mountain scenery and winding roads, I'm looking forward to a change of pace: a leisurely drive, time along the waterfront, and another opportunity to appreciate the beauty of northern Italy. More to come as the day unfolds.
